nodes.text:
🇰🇿 Kazakhstan, following China, reported cases of infection with the deadly metapneumovirus — more than 30 cases of infection have been recorded

“Since the beginning of the epidemic season, 8,360 samples have been tested for non-influenza viruses in the republic. https://t.co/0Bs9sSc54q

nodes.author: volkova_ma57183
nodes.text: Of these, 1,866 (22%) positive samples were detected, including coronavirus — 206 (11.1%), parainfluenza — 178 (9.5%), bocavirus — 113 (6.1%) and, last but not least, metapneumovirus — 30 (1.6%),” the press service of the republic’s Ministry of Health said in a statement.

nodes.author: volkova_ma57183
nodes.text:
There is no treatment aimed at the virus, so only symptomatic therapy is used.

The first cases of metapneumovirus have been recorded in the UK.

Taiwan has called for people to return to wearing masks and added that the situation is now under control.
